Location: Pune

About ArcelorMittal

ArcelorMittal is the worlds leading steel and mining company, with a strong global presence across more than 60 countries. We are committed to sustainable growth, operational excellence, and building a highperformance culture driven by innovation and collaboration.

Job Description

We are currently looking for an experienced Senior GL / R2R Accountant to join our Finance team at ArcelorMittal. The role involves managing endtoend General Ledger and RecordtoReport (R2R) activities in a shared services / multinational environment, ensuring accurate financial reporting and timely monthend close.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform General Ledger (GL) accounting, including account reconciliations and balance sheet reviews
• Manage intercompany accounting, reconciliations, and settlements across entities
• Handle monthend close activities, including preparation and posting of Manual Journal Entries (MJEs)
• Support financial consolidation and reporting activities
• Perform foreign exchange (FX) revaluation and analyze currency impacts
• Ensure compliance with IFRS / GAAP, internal controls, and audit requirements
• Work extensively on SAP (FI/CO, SAP HANA) for accounting and reporting
• Use advanced Excel for data analysis and reporting

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelors or Masters degree in Accounting / Finance (BCom, MCom, MBA Finance, CA, CPA preferred)
• 5 years of relevant experience in GL / R2R accounting
• Strong exposure to SAP FI/CO or SAP HANA
• Experience working in shared services / MNC environments
• Good analytical and communication skills

Top 4 Mandatory Skills (Please confirm experience)

Candidates must have handson experience in:

• General Ledger (GL) / R2R Accounting
• MonthEnd Close & Manual Journal Entries (MJE)
• Intercompany Accounting & Reconciliations
• SAP FI/CO or SAP HANA

How to Apply

Interested candidates may share their updated resume at sourav.roy.contractor@arcelormittal.com Please mention the following details in your email:

• Total years of experience
• Current company
• Notice period
• Current CTC
• Expected CTC
• Confirmation of experience in the 4 mandatory skills listed above

data.job_description:
Location: Pune, India — On-site

On behalf of our client, a German manufacturing company and one of the leading global companies in its segment - we are seeking an experienced Head of Accounting & Taxation for their Indian subsidiary.

This is a leadership role with end-to-end responsibility for accounting, taxation, statutory reporting, compliance, and internal controls. Acting as a trusted partner to local management and global headquarters, the position plays a pivotal role in safeguarding financial integrity, ensuring regulatory compliance and sustainable business growth.

The role reports directly to the Managing Director India, with a functional reporting line to the Group CFO at headquarters in Germany.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and oversee all accounting operations in compliance with Ind AS, Indian statutory requirements, and company policies.
• Ensure the timely and accurate preparation of statutory financial statements, management reports, and other reporting requirements.
• Manage all tax-related matters, including GST, income tax, tax compliance, filings, assessments, and coordination with external advisors and authorities.
• Maintain and optimize internal controls and ensure adherence to applicable statutory, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements.
• Conduct financial reviews, variance analysis, balance sheet reviews, and KPI monitoring to ensure accounting accuracy, reporting quality, and sound business decision-making.
• Prepared and closely monitor overall company’s cash flow to ensure optimal utilization of funds.
• Review overall profit and loss statement / MIS every month to ensure profit margins are aligned with overall target.
• Drive process optimization, cost control, and operational efficiency initiatives
• Lead, develop, and motivate the local accounting team (currently 3 FTE).
• Promote a culture of integrity, transparency, accountability, and ethical business conduct.

Your Profile

• Professional qualification as a Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Current or recent experience in an industrial manufacturing environment, with at least 6 years in this field.
• Experience working in multinational companies (MNCs) and handling cross-border transactions.
• Strong hands-on experience in financial closing, payroll management, accounting, taxation, and controlling, with sound knowledge of TDS and GST compliance.
• Have a sound knowledge of IFRS and IndAS to ensure financial statements are adhered with relevant standards.
• Experience in implementing overall governance and controls across all core business and support functions in an organisation.
• Led initiatives for cost saving activities to contribute towards positive profit margins.
• Solid knowledge of Infor M3 or comparable ERP systems.
• Experience with Power BI or any data analytics tool or similar business intelligence tools is strongly preferred.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting systems.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Strong commitment to compliance, internal controls, and ethical business practices.
• Fluent business English is required.

Our Client Offers

• A key leadership position in a stable and growing international manufacturing company
• High visibility and close collaboration with senior management and global headquarters
• The Opportunity to shape financial processes and contribute to business strategy
• Broad exposure to accounting, taxation, compliance, and business partnering.
• Professional development opportunities and long-term career prospects in an international environment
• Competitive compensation package aligned with market standards

We look forward to receiving your application.

Please submit your CV and earliest possible start date to:

Marina Döhling

Position Title: Finance Business Analyst

Location: Pune

Position Overview

The Business Analyst reports directly to the IMEA Finance Business Partner and indirectly to the regional General Manager.
The primary objective of the job holder is to support the IMEA region, contributing to the development and implementation of overall business strategy and the day-to-day operations of the business.

This role also ensures the optimization of business financial results by proactively monitoring financial trends, performance metrics and responding with value-added analysis to facilitate decision making. This role is supporting the International Growth Market organization, which is active across all three Global Business Units of H.B. Fuller.

Primary Responsibilities:

Finance Business Partnering (55%)
• Weekly validation of account and market mappings for all business units within IMEA to ensure accurate reporting by GSMs, AMs, SAMs, ISAMs, and BDMs.

• First contact point for the local sales team to answer or redirect any financial questions on sales, contribution or gross margin.

• Support the local management in understanding, reviewing and optimizing the P&L.

• Provide ongoing support to the commercial team through:
• BI tool training and troubleshooting.

• Manual report generation from BI to enhance visibility of business performance.

• Preparation of presentations for key business updates.

• Calculate monthly sales commissions for external agents and annual compensation reports across the IMEA region.

• Perform variance analysis in collaboration with the commercial team to identify performance gaps and support action planning. To mention margin analysis and positive pricing as examples.

• Assist with in-depth sales analysis and provide monthly forecasting support when needed, based on business performance trends.

Forecasting & Budgeting (25%)
• Assist in the financial outlook process during Feb/May/Aug:
• Prepare a consolidated master file with actuals by market segment.

• Challenge the commercial team to give a realistic forecast that ensures year-over-year growth.

• Gather inputs from individual GSMs and consolidate for regional reporting

• Lead the creation of customer-level budgets:
• Ensure all customer accounts are included.

• Validate market accuracy and adjust allocations where necessary.

Ad Hoc Operational Support (15%)
• Raise and manage correction and extension tickets in Ivanti and Power BI to support accurate invoicing and system data integrity.

• Coordinate cross-functional approvals with MDM, Customer Service, Finance, Tax, and Credit teams for changes in SAP.

• Support Customer Service team with:
• Customer and product extensions

• Address modifications and commodity code updates.

• Review and approve new customer account creation requests.

Projects (5%)
• “Conduct biweekly follow-ups with the commercial team to ensure progress and alignment with project objectives and targets.”.

Minimum Requirements
• BA or BS degree required with strong background in finance / business management

• 3+ years of experience in finance or accounting (FP&A. Accounting, Business Analyst, Corporate Finance, Commercial Finance, Audit, Financial Consulting, etc.)

• Highly proficient in the use of Microsoft office tools, notably, Excel and Power BI.

• International experience, either through studying abroad or working experience

• Individual accountability for results

• Model collaboration and commitment, also managing remote relationships effectively

• Seeking solutions that improve process effectiveness and drive continuous improvement

• Anticipating and responding to changes in financial trends proactively

• Driver’s license to be able to regularly visit office and production facilities within the region.
